title: Singapore Self-Realization Course For Spiritual Enlightenment Announced | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
Teacher Tian Lin is pleased to be offering a new three-day online workshop to spiritual practitioners in Singapore who are interested in self-realization.
Taipei, Taiwan, Province of China, March 19, 2025 -- Teacher Tian Lin has announced that he will be hosting a new three-day online course called ‘Meet the True and Complete You 2.0’, which distills the wisdom that Tian Lin has accrued as a lifelong spiritual practitioner and as an esteemed mentor and guide.
More information is available at https://tianlin520.blogspot.com/
This unique online workshop will integrate established practices like meditation and mindfulness with unique methodologies that Teacher Tian Lin has pioneered to help people awaken and ascend to a higher state of consciousness.
As Tian Lin himself explained, while many people today covet spiritual enlightenment and self-realization, the path towards this kind of awareness seems more complex than ever to achieve; something he blames on the proliferation of so-called self-help gurus who seek to spread wisdom before they truly obtain knowledge.
In particular, Tian Lin’s teachings reject the now governing assumption that to achieve Samadhi, or a true union with the divine, one must shed what is earthly and creatural; including the fleshiness of the body, relationships with family and friends, and careers.
Rather, Tian Lin advocates that Buddha-nature is in everything. Therefore, in his new three-day workshop—the first of its kind—he will teach his students not to abstain or withdraw from life in order to find the stillness that will allow them to achieve enlightenment, but rather to expand the limits of their body and mind in order to see and feel the Buddha-nature that exists all around them, including within them.
As he described, “True spiritual practice is actually about continuously expanding and challenging the various possibilities of the self. This means that our body and mind should be fully engaged, and at the same time, we should recognize the inherent purity and stillness within.”
Teacher Tian Lin encourages interested Singapore-based spiritual practitioners to find out more information about his new course online, and to discover more about his teaching philosophy on his YouTube channel, where the videos regularly draw tens of thousands of views.
He added, “The truth is—you are inherently already the supreme enlightenment. You have already awakened and seen your true nature. The real question is not whether you have left the secular world, but whether you have recognized the inherent Buddha-nature in all beings?”
For more information, visit https://www.youtube.com/@tianlin777
